text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup is almost here. Manhattan Cafe reflects on all the rivals she's raced against while following her friend's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week derives her strength from food, while a hidden ferocity lurks deep within Silence Suzuka. These are the sources of their running ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So where does Zenno Rob Roy's get her strength? She tells us herself—it's her unbreakable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following her friend's guidance, Manhattan Cafe begins to gather the pieces she needs to assemble a strength that's uniquely hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And the Japan Cup might just be where those pieces come together.
